verdict.rationale: The docs describe a Weave Service API with REST endpoints, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found 404 at every common OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.wandb.ai. Having a REST API is related to this story but does not deliver a published spec file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
